question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The solution is **climbed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3, "Large crowds daily (3)_______ up the hill to see through (4)_______ telescope." is climbed.
 
• Large crowds daily climbed up the hill to see through (4)_______ telescope.
 
• Here, the word climbed is used because the action that was done is in the past, so the past form of climbed is used.
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:

 
 
• **​Paused - **Interrupt action or speech briefly.
 
• **Backed - **Give financial, material, or moral support to.
 
• **Watched - **Look at or observe attentively over a period of time.
